nom: EQQUALBERRY Swimming Pool Toner - Korean Toner for Daily Exfoliating & Deep Hydration with Natural Enzyme Protease & Hya

avis.texte: I was a little skeptical how well this would perform, because it got so viral online. It’s hard to tell what to believe sometimes. Anyways, I have to say, this is actually a very decent toner! The texture is a lot like a serum, which I really like. The exfoliation is super gentle. I have sensitive skin, and I use this every other day or every two days. I could probably use this every day, but I don’t feel like I need to because this toner seems to do its job well. This will definitely last me a long time. I use this at night, and when I wake up I have noticed my complexion is a bit brighter and glowy/healthy. I think the berry extracts have something to do with it. It’s also quite hydrating but not sticky. I have combo skin that runs on the oily side, and I haven’t had any issues. SKIN TYPE: Combination-oily, dehydrated ROUTINE: Senka foaming face wash, Swimming Pool toner, Isntree Ultra HA toner or Torriden Dive in Serum, Dr 19 Peptide Jelly toner, Dr Althea 345 Cream or Torriden Dive In Cream

I’ve been using the EQQUALBERRY Swimming Pool Toner for a few weeks now, and I’m really impressed with the results. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky feeling. It gives my skin an instant boost of hydration and leaves it feeling fresh and smooth. I have sensitive skin, and this toner hasn’t caused any irritation at all. The gentle exfoliation helps improve my skin texture over time, making it look brighter and more even. I also love that it contains hyaluronic acid, which keeps my skin well-moisturized throughout the day. Overall, this is a great daily toner, especially if you’re looking for something hydrating yet mildly exfoliating. Definitely worth trying!

It is hard to describe exactly how amazing this toner is. It exfoliates my skin very well overnight, when I wash my face in the morning with my gentle cleanser, the difference in brightness & texture is astounding. I will continue buying this toner as long as it works for me & I recommend it to my friends and family.

This product is amazing! It exfoliates so gently and gives your face such a beautiful sheen! The texture is also very nice too! There is no smell either! I absolutely love this product and will repurchase in a heartbeat!
Omg truly an amazing toner, it helped rid the stubborn texture and kept the area so smooth.
Really like how light this toner is and provides the perfect amount of hydration for my skin type (combination). Use it all the time.

This toner may very well work so well for most people but be very careful on how it works on you personally. I completely broke out on my legs but anywhere else on my body was fine I unfortunately have to stop using it im feeling extremely disappointed but this stuff happens when it comes to skin care so be careful guys.

avis.titre: Good tonic if you want to feel you face fresh
avis.texte: Truly a feeling as if you stuck your face in a pool of water. I combine this toner with other Korean skin beauty products, it does lightly exfoliate and also moisturises well
as expected.. good value. superior quality for dry, sensitive skin, especially my post travel skin
This toner is amazing. It’s super gentle but makes my skin feel so so smooth and hydrated. Will be repurchasing
Bester Toner wirklich! Beruhigt die Haut, versorgt sie mit Feuchtigkeit und lässt kleine Trockenheitsfältchen verschwinden.

avis.titre: Great Hydrating Toner That Leaves Skin Smooth and Refreshed!
avis.texte: I’ve been using the EQQUALBERRY Swimming Pool Toner for a while now and I really like it. It feels very refreshing and lightweight on the skin. The toner hydrates well without feeling sticky, and it leaves my face feeling soft and smooth. I also like that it gently exfoliates while still being moisturizing. It’s great for daily use and helps my skin look brighter and more balanced. Definitely a nice addition to my skincare routine.

avis.titre: What the hell is in this stuff?
avis.texte: See that reddish dot by my eye that was a beauty mark, and I noticed after the first day of using this toner, I noticed that the beauty mark was like pushing something out like milla so I kind of picked at it and nothing came out and it was a scab and all of a sudden I woke up this morning and it’s gone. The beauty mark is no longer there and I used to have a dot there my entire life I noticed all the milla underneath my eye like the little tiny bumps are starting to go away too. My face feels so much better after this stuff. The dark acne spots got lighter within days.

Tras unas semanas de uso, noté una mejoría visible en la luminosidad y suavidad de la piel. Es un tónico ideal para quienes buscan hidratar sin sensación grasa, refrescar la piel tras la limpieza y preparar el rostro para los siguientes pasos del skincare. Ideal para:Pieles normales, secas o deshidratadas. Quienes buscan un producto suave pero eficaz para uso diario. Personas que desean una piel más lisa, hidratada y con aspecto saludable. Consejo:Aplicar con un algodón o con las manos dando suaves toques después de la limpieza. Puede usarse mañana y noche.
It's a good toner for those looking to keep their skin hydrated and balanced; it feels somewhat warm and thick on the skin, but it's bearable and good.

avis.titre: I love this toner and how smooth and protective it makes the skin feel.

avis.titre: one of the best I've tried
avis.texte: It leaves your skin feeling very soft and when you wake up your face has a beautiful glow. One of my favorite products.

avis.titre: I am very confused by the “Swimming Pool” name and…
avis.texte: …I don’t really understand how toners are supposed to work. I have several different types and they all say either swipe over face with cotton round or pat into face with fingers after washing. How do they exfoliate or remove “dead skin cells, leaving your complexion clearer and more refined” if they don’t get rinsed off—especially if you just use your fingers to tap it into the skin?!? This preamble is just my way of saying that I don’t know what this EQQUALBERRY toner is actually doing for my face, if anything. After first use, my skin didn’t feel or look any different and it just kind of felt like thick water when applied. It clearly is not just water since it took a few minutes to sink in and, true to the listing, there was no residue of any kind left behind. I like that this is unscented, there are no harsh chemical exfoliants, that it is safe for sensitive skin and daily use, that it contains beneficial hydrating hyaluronic acid and “naturally derived protease enzymes” (plants they are derived from in order listed on package are: açaí, blackberry, cranberry, blueberry, raspberry, black elderberry), but I’ve seen no evidence that the “gentle exfoliation process minimizes pores and removes dead skin cells, leaving your complexion clearer and more refined,” so far. I currently have four different toners that I have been using/testing ranging in price from $0.94/oz to $4.05/oz. My most expensive toner is not as thick and lasts me up to six months. It is very gentle and I use it at night. Only if my Skin is very stressed out, I will only limit it to a couple times a week.. I always followed up with a hydrating toner after wood right now I’m using April skin(greenbottle) or anua 70 soothing toner or Titir light, milky toner. avis.titre: Effective new toner in my routine !
avis.texte: I prefer an uncomplicated, straightforward skincare routine, and the EQQUALBERRY Swimming Pool Facial Toner has fit in seamlessly. Its unscented, silky formula is a delight, it leaves my skin feeling refreshed and smooth, enhancing my routine without complicating it. Highly recommended for its quality and effectiveness!
Dry very acne prone skin Gave me acne which is disappointing bc I've been wanting to try it for so long and it's expensive. Great quality for dry skin if you aren't acne prone
Gave my kids rashes after using this. Started to have tiny bumps, red and itchiness all around his face. The product said Irritant-free. I dont think so. Not for sensitive skin at all.
I used this product for three days, and by the third day I had this bumpy red raised rash all over my forehead. I’ve never had this issue with a product before. Would not buy again.

avis.titre: Lightweight, Hydrating Toner with Great Ingredients
avis.texte: This has become one of my favorite toners. It has a light, watery texture with a very slight body that spreads easily across the skin and absorbs quickly. There is only a slight tackiness at first; it fades completely once the product dries. The formula is fragrance free with a neutral pH, which I really appreciate. It also includes several excellent skin-friendly ingredients. Glycerin and beta glucan provide great hydration; panthenol, betaine, and allantoin help support the skin barrier. The fruit extracts add a very gentle exfoliating effect without feeling harsh. I have mature combination skin, and this works beautifully as part of my night routine. My skin feels fresh, hydrated, and noticeably plumper after using it.

avis.titre: Gentle, Dewy, and So Refreshing - A Toner I Actually Look Forward To!
avis.texte: This toner has such a calming, refreshing feel - the texture is thicker than water, almost essence-like, and it smooths over my skin in the softest way.! My combination skin leans dehydrated, and a lot of exfoliators make me itchy or flushed, but this one has been incredibly gentle from the very first use. No stinging, no redness… just a comfortable, hydrated finish. I’ve been using it once a day for about three weeks, and it quickly became one of those steps I genuinely look forward to. The first thing I noticed was how much smoother my nose felt after applying it - that area always gets a little rough, and this made it feel softer without any harshness. My skin also tends to feel more hydrated afterward, almost like it holds onto moisture a bit better. “Swimming Pool” really is the perfect name, because it leaves my face with that plump, dewy feeling that makes everything else glide on so easily. The bottle is easy to open and dispense from, and the opening releases just the right amount without splashing or running too fast. I apply it with my hands using a gentle splash-and-pat method, and the texture spreads evenly without slipping everywhere. I go with a grape-sized amount (for my face, neck and chest area), let it settle for a few minutes, and sometimes add a thinner second layer. Once it absorbs, it leaves my skin smooth and well-prepped for the rest of my skincare or anything I apply afterward. It wears comfortably under sunscreen and makeup without feeling heavy or

avis.titre: Now I understand what all the fuss is about!
avis.texte: This is a smaller bottle Eqqualberry is now offering of their incredibly popular Swimming Pool Toner. I’ve heard about it everywhere. Blogs. Chat boards. Beauty mags. And now I understand why. Ok, so first maybe I should start by saying that this toner, like many Korean made toners, are not the toners many of us are used to. Or at least us older folks. Remember witch hazel toners? UGH!!! I tried them more than once because everyone seemed to use them and they sucked the living soul out of my skin. I was afraid to go near a toner again for nearly 2 decades. Enter Korean skincare and their hydrating toners! They were exactly what I’d always wanted. And this Swimming Pool toner is a perfect example. The ingredients in this are 1st rate. Good, quality skincare with effective ingredients and nothing junky or potentially problematic. This is alcohol free, fragrance free and essential oil free. It’s full of hydrating and soothing ingredients like panthenol, allantoin, hyaluronic acid and different fruit extracts. And the texture! It feels more like a serum than a toner to me. It a bit heavier than water and slick. It spreads like a dream and wraps your face in a hydrating layer. It takes a minute or 2 for it to absorb and dry down and when it does it’s not sticky or tacky. My skin feels wrapped in a moisturizing protective layer. It even makes it feel a little firmer and plumper. So yeah. Now I know why this toner so has many rave reviews. If you want clean hydration, this is a grea

I've been using one specific toner for the past few months, and was looking for something a bit better. I am thrilled that the first new one I tried was exactly what I was looking for! I've heard great things about this brand, and the ingredient list checks all my boxes. I love that there is so many different fruit extracts included. I've always found fruit facial masks to do wonderful things for my skin, so seeing the same fruits in this toner gave me a lot of hope. I can say I was not disappointed at all! I've been using this now for about a week and a half. I use it for both my morning as well as my evening skincare routine, and I use it with a cleanser (first, then this toner), three different serums, and a cream. I can fully say that I feel the difference between this and my prior toner. Partly because my skin just FEELS better, even before putting on my serums and cream, but also it seems like my serums take to my face better after using this. They absorb quicker, and my skin feels more hydrated. I've also noticed a reduction in the depth of my fine lines, but I think that's more due to the serums that I use, which this toner allows to penetrate deeper. I don't know if this is the cause or the catalyst, but either way, I am in love with this toner! I highly recommend it.

avis.titre: A great inexpensive way to feel hydrated on your skin
avis.texte: Want get hydrated skin for cheap? The Swimming Pool Toner from EQQUALBERRY is a fantastic Korean toner for daily exfoliation and skin hydration. Pros: - Scentless fragrance smell - Refreshing feeling on skin - The serum has a thin texture for it but still thicker than water - Does not cause irritation on dry or sensitive skin - Saw great skin results in just two weeks! - Big bottle for cheap, great value! Cons: - The "swimming pool" product description can cause confusion at first.

avis.titre: Simple but effective to help me avoid pimple breakouts
avis.texte: I wasn't sure what to think about a "swimming pool toner," but I had heard good things from someone else before, so I decided to give it a try, and I am glad I did. When I applied it, I felt the cleansing of my skin and the removal of the day's residue since I live in a humid area. I like that it does not have any fragrance, so I knew that my skin was less likely to have a bad reaction to it. A good toner has always been my go-to because it is what hydrates my skin and helps me with avoiding breakouts. I can use anything else, but a toner comes first, and this is a great one. It is pretty simple but effective, and it does not irritate my skin. I can use it daily and do not get extra bumps or redness; to the contrary, I feel my skin is healing and more soothing. It comes in a 5.24 OZ bottle, which is a great size for me because it is not a tiny amount, and it is something I will use on a daily basis. Overall, I am happy with getting the Swimming Pool Toner (Korean toner).

avis.titre: A Refreshing, Texture-Improving Toner with Zero Irritation
avis.texte: I’ve been using this toner for about two weeks now, and I’m really impressed with the results. It feels more like an essence than a traditional toner this is lightweight, hydrating and very soothing on the skin. I have sensitive, combination skin and this has been really gentle with zero irritation. There’s no scent , which I really appreciate on days when my skin feels reactive. Even with this being so gentle, it still delivers noticeable results. I’ve already seen a significant improvement in my skin texture and overall smoothness. This toner feels refreshing, calming and gives that boost of hydration that makes the rest of my skincare apply even better. It has become a staple in both my morning and nighttime routine and I love how healthy and balanced my skin looks since adding it in.

I have really started to love EQQUALBERRY products, and this Swimming Pool Toner is the latest reason why. I have sensitive skin and rosacea, so it can be difficult to find products that work with my skin, especially when so many skin care products contain fragrance (which I will never understand). Every EQQUALBERRY product I have tried so far has been fantastic, including this toner. This toner is fragrance-free, alcohol-free, and doesn't have other potentially sensitizing ingredients like essential oils. The ingredients are incredible and include things like panthenol, which my skin responds very well to. It feels funny to say that a toner is moisturizing, but this one is, thanks to the ingredients. My skin feels plumper and more hydrated after I use this toner; I put it on immediately after I take a shower to lock in moisture, and it's working really well for me. It applies easily and absorbs quickly, and there is no stickiness. Once it has fully absorbed, I apply my EQQUALBERRY serum. My skin looks and feels fantastic, and I attribute to these products and this toner in particular. It has been a real step up in my skincare. This is a wonderful product for sensitive skin or any skin type.

I absolutely adore EQQUALBERRY's products and was so excited to get to try their Swimming Pool Toner! This toner arrived in a nice bottle with a dropper top, which makes it very easy to place a few drops in my hand and pat into my face. This toner absorbs really well and very quickly, which is awesome! I prefer doing the seven skin method which involves layering toners, but they have to be quick to absorb or this process takes forever. This is a perfect toner for layering. The ingredients are fantastic, like Panthenol, Hyaluronic Acid, blackberry, cranberry, blueberry and raspberry fruit extracts. These seem to agree well with dry and aging skin. My face feels so hydrated, nourished and seems to be shrinking my pores. It leaves a nice glassy glow after using! I appreciate that there are no added colors, it's fragrance free, and that the list of ingredients is small. The texture is slightly thicker than a watery toner. I am happy to report that I have not had any adverse reaction at all. Ultimately, I think this is an incredible, quality toner with awesome ingredients that is very effective. $14.99 for a 5.24 ounce bottle makes this a great value, and it's very giftable so I recommend sticking it in someone's stocking this Christmas!

This review is for EQQUALBERRY's Swimming Pool Toner - Korean Toner for Daily Exfoliating & Deep Hydration with Natural Enzyme Protease & Hyaluronic Acid, For Sensitive Skin, 5.24 Fl Oz (155ml). Swimming Pool Toner is a rare find! This is an extremely gentle exfoliating toner that is gentle on my sensitive skin. I have been using this for a month and will continue to do so as it never ceases to amaze me. Name is perfect as it feels like I just swam in a saltwater pool. The gentle texture is easy on the skin and keeping my dry and sensitive skin hydrated, even as the weather gets cooler. This effect lasts through the day. Texture is thicker than water. It is not at all sticky. There is no scent. It does not irritate my skin and I have noticed reduced redness and smoother texture. Swimming pool toner is a nice base layer moisturizer and sunscreen. I look forward to using this each morning and will continue to do so.
I’ve only been using it for less than a week and I’ve noticed quite a change in my skin, clearer and smoother. It’s gentle for everyday use. I like this better than previous one.

I'm so confused as to why this is called Swimming Pool Toner but it is truely an amazing toner. Its made in Korea and is a nice gel like formula. You dont even need a cotton swab to apply. I simply put a coin size amount in my hand and rubbed in. Rubs in and absorbs nicely and feel super refreshing. Dries quickly and my skin feels so nice and clean. I apply it before I put on my makeup. I've had no irritation and I love that there is no strong perfumy scent. I am so happy with how this makes my skin feel and will continue to use daily. I think the price is fair considering how long this is going to last you. Overall, I'm pleased!

avis.titre: Gently exfoliated my sensitive skin; fragrance-free; uses enzymes instead of acids
avis.texte: This hydrating toner gently exfoliated my skin using protease enzymes that are included to exfoliate the skin more gently than hydroxy acids. I have rosacea and very sensitive skin which is irritated by strong AHAs and BHAs, and this formula effectively and gently exfoliated my skin without irritation. I love that it contains numerous humectants and hyaluronic acid, as well as extracts from five different berries. I also really appreciate that this formula is fragrance-free because my skin can't tolerate fragrance. This toner is also a very good value for a high-quality Korean skincare product. I included a photo of the full ingredient list so that potential buyers can evaluate the ingredients themselves.

Been using this in mornings before any other applications. Very good early morning for hydration that lasts for almost the whole day, and then another application at night before going to bed for my night routine. Doesn't come with a spray attachment like some toners do, but I had a spare pump from an empty bottle of something else that just happened to fit in this. Some people also like to do a mix of water and toner as a setting, so if you have a spare empty bottle you could empty half of this into there and fill it halfway with water to use that way. Current trends also have people adding a few drops of this to foundation, which I have tried and it seems ok, but it depends heavily on the thickness of the toner. This one might by a bit thick for doing that. Overall very pleased with this.

I really love this toner. The texture is a little thicker than most, almost like a light gel, and it feels so calming and hydrating on my skin. It absorbs nicely and leaves my face soft and refreshed without any stickiness. The packaging looks clean and minimal, which makes it feel a bit more high end too. It’s gentle, soothing, and gives my skin that fresh, healthy look. It’s definitely a new favorite.
Gave me small bumps on my face when I didn’t even have them in the first place. Now I have these ugly closed comedones! 😭😭😭 Now I have to heal my face! FRUSTRATING

This is seriously the best exfoliate ever, no bs. If you have ever struggled with those tiny bumps on your skin that you can really pop or have stubborn skin texture, THIS IS PERFECT FOR YOU! It’s a lightweight hydrating consistency, which is perfect to use at night or day. I’ve had this toner for about 7-8 months and it’s still going strong! For reference, I have sensitive semi-dry skin. The only trouble I’ve had with this product is because I sometimes over use it. I notice when I use it every day and night consistently, my skin starts to freak out a little. Which is expected if you’re using an exfoliant everyday. (Please don’t over exfoliate your skin, it’s not fun) So i recommend using it every other day. This is truly an amazing product and it is so underrated. If you’re looking for a gentle exfoliation, this product is your best friend. Notes: I’ve found it actually fades my dark Spots And if you’re wondering if it has a scent, no it does not. I found results within a week and a half btw.

This toner from EQQUALBERRY threw me off at first because it was titled "pool toner" which led me to believe it was a swimming pool treatment product. Thankfully, upon closer inspection, this is a toner for your skin! This toner has zero scent to it which makes it friendly to those who are sensitive to fragrance in their skincare and arrived in a large bottle with a generous size of over 10 ounces! Wow! The ingredients are very good and I think the formulation is non-sticky as it absorbed quickly into my skin. I think I could only ever complain about the name because it's very confusing at first if you're unfamiliar with this K-Beauty brand. Otherwise, this toner worked well for my skin and left it feeling super hydrated!

As the branding suggests, it's mainly used for dry skin caused by a chemical dryness, usually chlorine from pools if you swim a lot. Obviously, that's not it's only use since skin can become dry via many means including just lower humidity in winter. It goes on and absorbs very easily so it doesn't spread all over clothing after a short time compared to some lotions or body butters. When it comes to tiny serum bottles, this is such a great value. It's a large bottle that not only hydrates your skin like a lotion, but also tones as well for over 10oz. You can't beat that value especially since korean imports are usually very expensive. This is a great value overall.
This toner feels so refreshing on my skin! It gives light exfoliation while keeping my face hydrated and smooth. I love how gentle it is but still makes my skin look brighter and healthier.”

Just to get this out of the way- the toner doesn't smell like (or as far as I can tell, have anything to do with) an actual swimming pool. Instead, it's nearly scentless, with a thin serum-like texture, and feels refreshing on my skin. It sinks in easily and doesn't leave my face sticky, slimy or greasy. Unlike some other exfoliating toners, it's not irritating or drying; instead it adds a light amount of moisture. After using it multiple times, my skin feels alright and has not broken out or gotten irritated, but it doesn't seem to be doing anything much other than feeling rather nice when applied after I wash my face. I don't see any difference in my pores or skin texture, which is the main purpose of the product, but it is nice enough to use that I am going to give it more time.

avis.titre: Amazing, smooth skin with this product!
avis.texte: I have slowly gotten into Korean skincare and I must say im q true believer and fan now! This is one of my staple skincare steps everyday and it leaves my face feeling moisturized and smooth. It is not sticky or scented strongly so it’s perfect if you are sensitive to that! Worth a try and great results for me personally!
Excelente producto la verdad muy bueno me ayuda muchísimo con los poro lo amé y la verdad me encanta los productos coreanos son buenísimos

avis.titre: It turns out to be the best skin toner I've ever had!!!!!!
avis.texte: Before buying this, I tried many Korean cosmetics that claimed to be good for hydration and strengthening the skin barrier. However, every product I used did not work well; they felt just like water. When they absorbed into my skin, I experienced some dryness. But this product is different. When I apply it to my skin, it makes my skin smoother and hydrates it without leaving a sticky texture. So, I applied it three times after it was absorbed by my skin. It works really well, and I highly recommend it to people who experience dryness and have skin troubles related to hydration.

avis.titre: Will not be ordering here again.
avis.texte: I received this one 1/4/2026. No box. No protective seal. Looks to me this was a return and still in the circulation at the warehouse. This is very unsanitary. Will not be ordering here again. Ordered replacement and received it today. This time it's in the box w/ protective seal. No issue with the product. It works great for my skin.

I can’t use chemical exfoliants as they give me rashes on my face, it is too harsh for my sensitive skin. But this toner is perfect, it helps smoothen out my skin texture, it hydrated and brightens too. I love it so much.

I have been using this toner for several days and am very impressed. I have a combination skin type, with some dry areas and some oily spots. Previously, I have primarily used witch hazel as a toner so I was surprised that the consistency of this is thicker and more gel-like. It could just as easily be applied with clean fingers as with a cotton pad. The feel of it is cool and smooth, and it absorbs quickly into the skin. Unlike harsher astringent toners, this is gentle and doesn’t feel irritating. If you have minor cuts or blemishes, there is no burning sensation. It is gentle enough for daily use. I have had a very small breakout since using it, but that is to be expected with a new skincare product - especially one that promotes cell turnover and draws out deeper impurities in the skin. Some of the blemishes have already cleared up and my skin both looks and feels smoother in those areas. As you need very little product to cover the entire face and neck area, this bottle will last a long time even with daily use.
